item.title: How Staged Builds Cache Third-Party Dependencies
item.description: In a non-staged build scenario, when we use a container to build, we can mount the cache directory inside the container onto the build host, run the build task, and then copy the artifacts into the runtime image to produce the application image. But with a staged build, the build image and the runtime image live in the same Dockerfile, which makes it harder to optimize the caching of third-party dependencies.

item.title: GitLab CI Continuous Integration
item.description: 1. Basic Concepts GitLab-CI: the continuous integration system provided by GitLab. It manages the build status of a project and runs build tasks through GitLab Runner. GitLab-Runner: used to execute build tasks. The script portion of .gitlab-ci.yml is run by GitLab-Runner. .gitlab-ci.yml: a file in the root directory of a git project that records a series of stages and execution rules.
